textos.A discussão gira em torno do roteiro e d: The discussion centers on the script and on the characters' conduct in the face of foolish choices. While most of those who recommend it enjoy these exasperating, irrational behaviors in the way the plot is driven, most of those who do not recommend it consider the protagonist irritating and her foolish decisions a narrative obstacle.
textos.A protagonista é insuportável e age de f: The protagonist is insufferable and acts selfishly, putting her friends' lives at risk just to satisfy her desires, which makes the experience frustrating.
textos.A trama tem ideias interessantes, mas nã: The plot has interesting ideas, but they are not developed, leaving loose ends and an ending that seems improvised.
textos.A premissa da mão possuída oferecia um g: The possessed hand premise offered great potential to explore themes like grief and addiction, but the film does not take advantage of it and gets lost in subplots.

textos.Além da protagonista, o elenco não conve: Apart from the protagonist, the cast does not convince and lacks charisma, leaving scenes lukewarm.
textos.Vários espectadores elogiaram a ideia or: Several viewers praised the original idea of the embalmed hand and the possession game, but felt that the development and execution did not live up to the potential, resulting in only a middling experience.
textos.Muitos comentaram que o filme demora a e: Many commented that the film is slow to get going, especially in the first half, and that this harms the pace and engagement with the story.
textos.A atuação da protagonista foi amplamente: The protagonist's performance was widely praised, but a good portion of viewers found the characters, especially the friends, immature and irritating, which caused frustration.
textos.Sustos e atmosfera: mais perturbador que: Scares and atmosphere: more disturbing than scary
textos.Apesar de não ser considerado um filme m: Despite not being considered a very scary film, many noted that it creates a disturbing, uncomfortable atmosphere, with well-executed possession scenes and body horror.
textos.O filme aborda temas como luto, solidão: The film addresses themes like grief, loneliness and dependence, and some viewers liked this depth, although they feel it was not well integrated into the main plot.
textos.O final dividiu opiniões: alguns acharam: The ending divided opinions: some found it clever and well tied up, while others were confused and frustrated by the lack of answers, finding the ending anticlimactic.
textos.Várias análises interpretam a trama como: Several analyses interpret the plot as a clear allegory for drug use, highlighting how the hand's ritual represents the seduction and devastating consequences of dependence, consuming those who seek an escape from pain.
textos.A performance de Sophie Wilde é amplamen: Sophie Wilde's performance is widely praised for conveying vulnerability and emotional deterioration convincingly, elevating the film with her intense, subtle presence.
textos.O trabalho de maquiagem e os efeitos prá: The makeup work and practical effects are highlighted as exceptional, with grotesque, disturbing scenes that leave a lasting impression.
textos.Muitos comentam que os protagonistas tom: Many comment that the protagonists make decisions so stupid they become irritating, but this also generates a morbid entertainment as the audience judges each wrong choice.
textos.O filme é elogiado por criar uma sensaçã: The film is praised for creating a constant sense of discomfort and fear that does not depend on cheap scares, but on a slow, oppressive tension that lingers after it ends.
textos.O desfecho é mencionado como satisfatóri: The ending is mentioned as satisfying and well tied up, with some analyses pointing to a parallel with an earlier scene that adds depth to the conclusion.

textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Michael P: Released in 2022 and directed by Michael Philippou, the horror film Talk to Me presents the story of a group of friends who learn to conjure spirits through an embalmed hand. Fascinated by the experience, they give themselves over to this practice until the breaking of limits opens the way for good into the spirit world.
textos.A condução da trama se apoia em uma atmo: The handling of the plot relies on an oppressive, disturbing atmosphere, combining moments of direct impact with stretches of a more measured pace.
textos.As avaliações mostram que os grupos conc: The ratings show that the groups agree on what the film is and address the same subjects, diverging strictly on the verdict about its effectiveness.
textos.Na maioria das notas (~67%), vários aval: In most ratings (~67%), several raters emphasize the metaphor of addiction and self-destruction tied to the ritual, while a good portion praise Sophie Wilde's performance. Additionally, some value the quality of the practical effects and makeup used in the scenes.
textos.Para quem se posiciona numa parcela das: For those who sit at a share of the ratings (~25%), many see the premise as creative but observe uneven execution in the development. In this view, a significant share complain about the slow, drawn-out pace of the story, while a smaller slice praise the performances but express discomfort with the characters' irritating behavior.
textos.Já na leitura que compõe uma fração míni: In the reading that makes up a minimal fraction of ratings (~8%), a considerable number disapprove of the protagonist and the sequence of foolish decisions throughout the events. In this same group, several consider the script weak and predictable, and a portion of them point to a clear underuse of the central premise's potential.
